title: A walk with somebody else
description: The route and the events of the walk are available to the owner without handing over their account.

blocks.text: On a walk with a dog walker, the owner’s phone stays at home. The tracker has to work in exactly that combination of devices.

quote.text: My dog walker took my dog on a walk and since they didn't have access to the app, the collar showed my dog all the way in downtown, miles away from the actual location.

blocks.text: The walker starts a separate session, and the owner sees the time of the last update and how the recording is going. When it ends, the route is saved with its markers.
A lost connection has to be visible. The last known point is not passed off as the current position.
